title: Apply Operations to an Array
sourceKind: search-snippets-only (official page returns 403 to WebFetch; statement taken from search-result summaries of secondary sites)
summary: For i from 0 to n-2, if nums[i] equals nums[i+1], double nums[i] and set nums[i+1] to 0 (operations applied in order). Then move all zeros to the end keeping non-zero order.
officialConstraints: Secondary summaries: 2 <= n <= 2000, values 0 to 1000 (not confirmed on the official page).
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps n at 50 values from 0 to 1000. Example [1,2,2,1,1,0] -> [1,4,2,0,0,0] comes from leetcode.doocs.org; not confirmed on the official page.
